sql_log.purpose: Measure frozen declared-graph and trigger-binding centrality without claiming runtime traffic.
sql_log.sql:
with callers as (
 select x->>'caller' caller,split_part(x->>'caller','.',2) caller_name,x->'callees' callees
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x where e.id=20161
), edges as (
 select caller,caller_name,c.value #>> '{}' callee from callers cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(callees)c
), nodes as (
 select caller identity,caller_name node_name from callers
), degrees as (
 select n.identity,n.node_name,
        (select count(*) from edges e where e.caller=n.identity) out_degree,
        (select count(*) from edges e where e.callee=n.node_name) in_degree
 from nodes n
), trig as (
 select x->>'function' function_name,count(*) trigger_bindings
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'trigger_bindings') x
 where e.id=20161 group by x->>'function'
)
select
 (select count(*) from nodes) caller_nodes,
 (select count(*) from edges) declared_edges,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',identity,'out_degree',out_degree,'in_degree',in_degree,'total_degree',out_degree+in_degree) order by out_degree+in_degree desc,identity) from degrees) declared_degree_table,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('function',function_name,'trigger_bindings',trigger_bindings) order by trigger_bindings desc,function_name) from trig) trigger_function_degree

sql_log.purpose: Find exact whitespace-normalized body duplicates in the bounded current related catalog.
sql_log.sql:
with f as (
 select p.oid,n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) identity_args,
        md5(regexp_replace(p.prosrc,E'\\s+','','g')) normalized_body_md5
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public')
 and (p.proname ilike '%input_governance%' or p.proname ilike '%input_readiness%')
), g as (
 select normalized_body_md5,count(*) members,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',oid,'schema',nspname,'name',proname,'identity_args',identity_args) order by nspname,proname,oid) objects
 from f group by normalized_body_md5 having count(*)>1
)
select (select count(*) from f) related_objects,
       (select count(*) from g) duplicate_body_groups,
       (select coalesce(sum(members),0) from g) objects_in_duplicate_groups,
       (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('normalized_body_md5',normalized_body_md5,'members',members,'objects',objects) order by members desc,normalized_body_md5) from g) duplicate_groups

sql_log.purpose: Inventory existing bounded manifest/context/cache/receipt surfaces and current privileges.
sql_log.sql:
with procs as (
 select 'FUNCTION' object_type,n.nspname schema_name,p.proname object_name,p.oid object_oid,
        pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) identity_args,
        p.prosecdef security_definer,has_function_privilege(current_user,p.oid,'EXECUTE') accessible
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public')
 and (p.proname ilike '%input_governance%' or p.proname ilike '%input_readiness%')
 and (p.proname ilike '%context%' or p.proname ilike '%manifest%' or p.proname ilike '%cache%' or p.proname ilike '%receipt%')
), rels as (
 select case c.relkind when 'r' then 'TABLE' when 'v' then 'VIEW' when 'm' then 'MATERIALIZED_VIEW' else c.relkind::text end object_type,
        n.nspname schema_name,c.relname object_name,c.oid object_oid,
        null::text identity_args,false security_definer,has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT') accessible
 from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public') and c.relkind in ('r','v','m')
 and (c.relname ilike '%input_governance%' or c.relname ilike '%input_readiness%')
 and (c.relname ilike '%context%' or c.relname ilike '%manifest%' or c.relname ilike '%cache%' or c.relname ilike '%receipt%')
), all_surfaces as (select * from procs union all select * from rels)
select count(*) surfaces,
 count(*) filter(where object_type='FUNCTION') function_surfaces,
 count(*) filter(where object_type<>'FUNCTION') relation_surfaces,
 count(*) filter(where accessible) accessible_surfaces,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type',object_type,'schema',schema_name,'name',object_name,'oid',object_oid,'identity_args',identity_args,'security_definer',security_definer,'accessible',accessible) order by object_type,schema_name,object_name,object_oid) inventory
from all_surfaces

order by p.proname,p.oid
